summary: Signify is division of Philips manufacturing lights and related products, founded in 2016. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 3 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: Eindhoven lighting company behind Philips Hue (€5.8 billion sales in 2025); 15 roles here, all in English, mostly internships.

culture.text: Staff often studied at TU/e, Fontys or Tilburg, mostly in business, electrical engineering, marketing or computer science.
Its careers site highlights trust, psychological safety and career development.
Most openings are in Eindhoven, some shared with Amsterdam or Brussels, across sales, marketing and data.

open.text: Signify N.V., Signify Holding B.V. and Signify Netherlands B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
None of its 15 jobs here require Dutch, though none mention visa support.
Good for students: 9 internships and 2 entry-level roles.

growth.text: Had €5.8 billion sales and about 27,000 employees in 2025.
Is shifting its strategy towards connected lighting.

worth_knowing.text: Earned an EcoVadis Platinum sustainability rating for the seventh year in a row.
